operatingBoundaryMap.whyItWins: Zero distributed consensus hop; server-side function executes inside primary shared_buffers.
Partition-affinity routing + compact delta-digest ctx.call eliminates SQL coordinator fan-out.
Local WASM linear-memory reduction avoids shipping raw event rows over the network.

operatingBoundaryMap.whyItWins: Epoch-fenced Raft learner catch-up and atomic leader handoff achieve 0 ms write stall.
In-partition Raft-apply delta rollups + lazy epoch cutover give 0ms staleness and 0s backfill.
